operator/release.py.text:
"""Login-node tool: release the held jobs of one submission after its record has been audited. Releases only the
recorded job IDs, only while every one of them is still a user-held pending job and the slurm scripts are
byte-identical to the record.   release.py <label>
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "runtime"))
import common as C  # noqa: E402

label = sys.argv[1]
record_path = C.ROOT / "evidence" / f"SUBMISSION_{label}.json"
released_path = C.ROOT / "evidence" / f"RELEASE_{label}.json"
C.require(record_path.exists(), f"no submission record for {label}")
C.require(not released_path.exists(), f"{label} already released")
record = C.read_json(record_path)
for key, script in record["scripts"].items():
    C.require(C.sha256_file(C.ROOT / script) == record["script_sha256"][key], f"script changed since submission: {script}")
for key, job in record["jobs"].items():
    info = subprocess.run(["scontrol", "show", "job", "-o", job], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout
    C.require("JobState=PENDING" in info and "Reason=JobHeldUser" in info, f"{key} job {job} is not user-held: {info[:200]}")
ids = list(record["jobs"].values())
subprocess.run(["scontrol", "release", ",".join(ids)], check=True)
after = {k: subprocess.run(["scontrol", "show", "job", "-o", j], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
         for k, j in record["jobs"].items()}
C.write_json(released_path, dict(C.META, status="released", label=label, released_at_utc=C.utc_now(),
                                 jobs=record["jobs"], scontrol_after_release=after))
print("released", ids)

operator/submit.py.text:
"""Login-node tool: submit one stage of this package, HELD (team rule: sbatch --hold, audit the record, then release
with operator/release.py <label>). Run only after the user approved that stage.

    submit.py stage1 [--dry-run]   preflight (CPU) -> CPU smoke of the five trainers (afterok)
    submit.py batch [--dry-run]    the 25 training runs (one chain per arm: fold k waits, afterany, for fold k-1 of the
                                   same arm, so at most 5 GPUs are held at a time), then the status summary (afterany)
    submit.py resume NAME          next attempt of a run whose last attempt FAILED or was CANCELLED (needs the user's
                                   approval each time)
    submit.py noshm NAME           run NAME again after its latest job found no /dev/shm space within the 20-minute wait
                                   (RUN_<NAME>_NOSHM_<job>), excluding those nodes; pending runs of the same chain get
                                   their dependency rewritten (p3.plan_noshm); at most shm.max_noshm_resubmits times
                                   per run; refuses anything that is not a recorded no-shm end
    submit.py summary              a status summary job alone

Derived from s2_p3_wave2_20261104_r5/operator/submit.py. Changed: no GPU smoke and no conditional runs; `batch`
replaces `wave2`; --dry-run (checks everything and prints the sbatch commands, calls no sbatch, writes nothing);
job names start with rcb_. Each real call appends every job id to evidence/SUBMISSION_<label>_TRAIL.txt as soon as
sbatch returns, then writes evidence/SUBMISSION_<label>.json (exclusive), so a partial submission can still be
cancelled precisely.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Dict, List

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "runtime"))
import common as C  # noqa: E402
import p3 as P  # noqa: E402

RUN = P.RUN
EVIDENCE = C.ROOT / "evidence"
MIN_FREE_GB = RUN["min_free_gb"]
TRAIN, SUMMARY = "slurm/30_train.slurm", "slurm/90_summary.slurm"


class Submission:  # r5's, unchanged
    def __init__(self, label: str):
        self.label = label
        self.record = EVIDENCE / f"SUBMISSION_{label}.json"
        self.trail = EVIDENCE / f"SUBMISSION_{label}_TRAIL.txt"
        C.require(not self.record.exists() and not self.trail.exists(), f"{label} already submitted")
        self.jobs: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self.scripts: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self.args: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}
        self.options: Dict[str, List[str]] = {}

    def sbatch(self, key: str, script: str, args: List[str], options: List[str]) -> str:
        cmd = ["sbatch", "--parsable", "--hold", *options, script, *args]
        job = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=C.ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.strip().split(";")[0]
        with self.trail.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            handle.write(f"{key} {job}\n")
        self.jobs[key] = job
        self.scripts[key] = script
        self.args[key], self.options[key] = list(args), list(options)
        return job

    def finish(self, free_gb: float, extra: Dict) -> None:
        sha = {key: C.sha256_file(C.ROOT / script) for key, script in self.scripts.items()}
        scontrol = {k: subprocess.run(["scontrol", "show", "job", "-o", j], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
                    for k, j in self.jobs.items()}
        C.write_json(self.record, dict(C.META, status="submitted_held", label=self.label, submitted_at_utc=C.utc_now(),
                                       manifest_sha256=C.sha256_file(C.ROOT / "MANIFEST.sha256"), jobs=self.jobs,
                                       scripts=self.scripts, script_sha256=sha, free_space_gb_at_submit=free_gb,
                                       args=self.args, options=self.options,
                                       scontrol=scontrol, **extra))
        print(f"HELD {self.label}: {self.jobs}\naudit {self.record}, then: python operator/release.py {self.label}")


class DryRun:
    def __init__(self, label: str):
        self.label, self.jobs = label, {}

    def sbatch(self, key: str, script: str, args: List[str], options: List[str]) -> str:
        self.jobs[key] = f"DRY{len(self.jobs) + 1}"
        print(f"{key}: sbatch --parsable --hold {' '.join(options)} {script} {' '.join(args)}")
        return self.jobs[key]

    def finish(self, free_gb: float, extra: Dict) -> None:
        print(f"DRY RUN OK ({self.label}): {len(self.jobs)} jobs would be submitted held; free {free_gb:.0f} GB; "
              f"nothing submitted")


def preamble(kind: str) -> float:
    C.verify_manifest()
    for script in sorted((C.ROOT / "slurm").glob("*.slurm")):
        subprocess.run(["bash", "-n", str(script)], check=True)
    free_gb = shutil.disk_usage(C.ROOT).free / 2 ** 30
    C.require(free_gb >= MIN_FREE_GB[kind], f"only {free_gb:.0f} GB free, need {MIN_FREE_GB[kind]}")
    if kind != "stage1":
        manifest = C.sha256_file(C.ROOT / "MANIFEST.sha256")
        for name in ("PREFLIGHT.json", "SMOKE_COMPLETE.json"):
            record = C.read_json(EVIDENCE / name)
            C.require(record["status"] == "pass" and record["manifest_sha256"] == manifest, f"{name} is not a pass for this manifest")
    return free_gb


def resource_options(spec: Dict) -> List[str]:
    res = P.resources(spec)
    # --no-requeue: a requeued run would hit its own STARTED record; reruns go through `resume` with approval
    return [f"--job-name=rcb_{spec['name']}", f"--partition={res['partition']}", "--gres=gpu:1",
            f"--cpus-per-task={res['cpus']}", f"--mem={res['mem']}", f"--time={res['time']}", "--no-requeue"]


def dependency_value(after_ok: List[str], after_any: List[str]) -> str:
    parts = ([f"afterok:{':'.join(after_ok)}"] if after_ok else []) + ([f"afterany:{':'.join(after_any)}"] if after_any else [])
    return ",".join(parts)


def dependency(after_ok: List[str], after_any: List[str]) -> List[str]:
    value = dependency_value(after_ok, after_any)
    return [f"--dependency={value}", "--kill-on-invalid-dep=yes"] if value else []


def submissions() -> List[Dict]:
    records = [C.read_json(p) for p in EVIDENCE.glob("SUBMISSION_*.json")]
    return sorted(records, key=lambda r: r["submitted_at_utc"])


def latest_jobs() -> Dict[str, str]:
    """Latest job id per key (run name, 'preflight', 'smoke', 'summary') over every submission record."""
    latest: Dict[str, str] = {}
    for record in submissions():
        latest.update(record["jobs"])
    return latest


def live_jobs() -> Dict[str, str]:
    out = subprocess.run(["squeue", "-h", "-u", os.environ["USER"], "-o", "%A %T"], capture_output=True, text=True,
                         check=True).stdout
    return dict(line.split() for line in out.splitlines() if line.strip())


def attempts(name: str) -> int:
    n = 0
    while (EVIDENCE / P.evidence_name("train", name, "STARTED", n)).exists():
        n += 1
    return n


def run_status(name: str, latest: Dict[str, str], live: Dict[str, str]) -> str:
    n = attempts(name)
    if n and (EVIDENCE / P.evidence_name("train", name, "COMPLETE", n - 1)).exists():
        return "complete"
    if name not in latest:
        return "unsubmitted"
    job = latest[name]
    if job in live:
        return "queued" if live[job] == "PENDING" else "running"
    if (EVIDENCE / f"RUN_{name}_NOSHM_{job}.json").exists():
        return "noshm"
    if n and any((EVIDENCE / P.evidence_name("train", name, w, n - 1)).exists() for w in ("FAILED", "CANCELLED")):
        return "failed"
    return "gone"


def label(kind: str) -> str:
    return f"{kind}_{datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')}"


def stage1(dry: bool) -> None:
    free_gb = preamble("stage1")
    C.require(not any((EVIDENCE / n).exists() for n in ("PREFLIGHT.json", "PREFLIGHT_FAILED.json", "RC_CASE_LISTS.json",
                                                       "SMOKE_STARTED.json")), "stage 1 already ran in this package")
    s = (DryRun if dry else Submission)("stage1")
    pre = s.sbatch("preflight", "slurm/00_preflight.slurm", [], [])
    s.sbatch("smoke", "slurm/10_smoke.slurm", [], ["--no-requeue"] + dependency([pre], []))
    s.finish(free_gb, {})


def batch(dry: bool) -> None:
    free_gb = preamble("batch")
    C.require(not any(EVIDENCE.glob("RUN_*_STARTED.json")) and not any(EVIDENCE.glob("SUBMISSION_batch*.json")),
              "the training runs were already submitted")
    P.check_wave2_graph(RUN["runs"], RUN["slots"], RUN["max_concurrent"])
    s = (DryRun if dry else Submission)("batch")
    for spec in RUN["runs"]:  # in RUN.json order, so every dependency already has a job id
        ok = [s.jobs[n] for n in spec["after_ok"]]
        any_ = [s.jobs[n] for n in spec["after_any"]]
        s.sbatch(spec["name"], TRAIN, [spec["name"]], resource_options(spec) + dependency(ok, any_))
    s.sbatch("summary", SUMMARY, [], ["--job-name=rcb_sum"] + dependency([], list(s.jobs.values())))
    s.finish(free_gb, {"slots": RUN["slots"]})


def resume(name: str) -> None:
    free_gb = preamble("resume")
    spec = P.spec_of("train", name)
    n = attempts(name)
    C.require(n > 0, f"{name} never started")
    C.require(any((EVIDENCE / P.evidence_name("train", name, w, n - 1)).exists() for w in ("FAILED", "CANCELLED")),
              f"attempt {n - 1} of {name} has no FAILED or CANCELLED record (still running?)")
    s = Submission(f"resume_{name}_A{n}")
    s.sbatch(name, TRAIN, [name, "--resume"], resource_options(spec))
    s.finish(free_gb, {"attempt": n})


def noshm(name: str) -> None:
    free_gb = preamble("noshm")
    specs = P.train_specs()
    C.require(name in specs, f"unknown run {name}")
    latest, live = latest_jobs(), live_jobs()
    C.require(name in latest, f"{name} was never submitted")
    job = latest[name]
    C.require((EVIDENCE / f"RUN_{name}_NOSHM_{job}.json").exists(), f"job {job} of {name} has no NOSHM record")
    done = len(list(EVIDENCE.glob(f"SUBMISSION_noshm_{name}_*.json")))
    C.require(done < RUN["shm"]["max_noshm_resubmits"], f"{name} already resubmitted {done} times for /dev/shm")
    status = {r: run_status(r, latest, live) for r in specs}
    resubmit, update = P.plan_noshm(list(specs.values()), name, status)
    exclude = sorted({C.read_json(p)["node"] for p in EVIDENCE.glob(f"RUN_{name}_NOSHM_*.json")})
    s = Submission(f"noshm_{name}_{done + 1}")

    def job_of(run: str) -> str:
        return s.jobs.get(run) or latest[run]

    for run, ok, any_ in resubmit:
        args = [run] + (["--resume"] if attempts(run) > 0 else [])
        options = resource_options(specs[run]) + ([f"--exclude={','.join(exclude)}"] if run == name else [])
        s.sbatch(run, TRAIN, args, options + dependency([job_of(d) for d in ok], [job_of(d) for d in any_]))
    rewritten = {}
    for run, ok, any_ in update:
        value = dependency_value([job_of(d) for d in ok], [job_of(d) for d in any_])
        subprocess.run(["scontrol", "update", f"JobId={latest[run]}", f"Dependency={value}"], check=True)
        rewritten[run] = {"job": latest[run], "dependency": value}
    s.sbatch("summary", SUMMARY, [], ["--job-name=rcb_sum"] + dependency([], list(s.jobs.values())))
    s.finish(free_gb, {"noshm_of": name, "previous_job": job, "exclude": exclude, "status_before": status,
                       "rewritten_dependencies": rewritten})


def summary() -> None:
    free_gb = preamble("summary")
    s = Submission(label("summary"))
    s.sbatch("summary", SUMMARY, [], ["--job-name=rcb_sum"])
    s.finish(free_gb, {})


if __name__ == "__main__":
    argv = sys.argv[1:]
    dry = "--dry-run" in argv
    argv = [a for a in argv if a != "--dry-run"]
    kind = argv[0] if argv else ""
    if kind == "stage1" and len(argv) == 1:
        stage1(dry)
    elif kind == "batch" and len(argv) == 1:
        batch(dry)
    elif kind == "resume" and len(argv) == 2 and not dry:
        resume(argv[1])
    elif kind == "noshm" and len(argv) == 2 and not dry:
        noshm(argv[1])
    elif kind == "summary" and len(argv) == 1 and not dry:
        summary()
    else:
        raise SystemExit(__doc__)

# RC training batch 1, job 30 (one A100): one training run, name in $1 (optional $2 = --resume). operator/submit.py passes the run's job name, cpus, memory and time limit from RUN.json; the launcher removes its /dev/shm copy on any exit.
set -euo pipefail
umask 027
ROOT=/public/home/zqchen/projects/ECNU_EYU_data/work_space/S2/experimental_unvalidated/s2_rc_train_batch1_20261112_r1

module purge
module load apps/envs/miniconda3/25.5.1
module load compiler/cuda/12.1
export PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 MKL_THREADING_LAYER=GNU
cd "$ROOT"
export PYTHONPATH="$ROOT/runtime"
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,driver_version --format=csv
exec "$PY" -B "$ROOT/runtime/launch_run.py" --run "$1" ${2:+"$2"}
